rule_title: TTP 1003.006 - DCSync Attack via Directory Replication by Non-DC Account (EID 4662)
description: Detects DCSync credential dumping via EID 4662 — a non-machine account accessing the domainDNS partition (ObjectType 19195a5b) with DS-Replication-Get-Changes GUIDs. GUID 1131f6aa is DS-Replication-Get-Changes and 1131f6ad is DS-Replication-Get-Changes-In-Filtered-Set — together they grant full password hash replication rights. SubjectUserName not ending in '$' excludes legitimate DC-to-DC replication (which always authenticates as a machine account).
